module_summary: 10GBASE-R receive interface: optionally bit-reverses and pipelines SERDES data, descrambles it with a 58-bit LFSR into registered encoded output, and runs block sync, BER monitor and watchdog children plus an optional PRBS31 error checker.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_data
anchors.why: Raw 64-bit SERDES receive data entering bit-reverse and pipeline.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_hdr
anchors.why: 2-bit sync header from SERDES used by block sync and monitors.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_data_int
anchors.why: Aligned/pipelined SERDES data feeding descrambler and PRBS checker.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_hdr_int
anchors.why: Aligned header fanned out to frame sync, BER monitor and watchdog.

anchors.name: descrambled_rx_data
anchors.why: Descrambler LFSR output registered as encoded data.

anchors.name: encoded_rx_data_reg
anchors.why: Output register for descrambled data driving encoded_rx_data.

anchors.name: encoded_rx_data
anchors.why: Descrambled 64-bit block data output to PCS decoder.

anchors.name: encoded_rx_hdr
anchors.why: Registered sync header output with encoded data.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_bitslip
anchors.why: Bitslip pulse from block sync, masked during PRBS31 test.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_reset_req
anchors.why: SERDES reset request from watchdog, masked during PRBS31 test.

anchors.name: rx_block_lock
anchors.why: Block lock status from frame sync, also feeds watchdog.

anchors.name: rx_high_ber
anchors.why: High bit-error-rate flag from BER monitor, also feeds watchdog.

anchors.name: cfg_rx_prbs31_enable
anchors.why: Enables PRBS31 checking and masks bitslip/reset; disabled by PRBS31_ENABLE=0.

anchors.name: prbs31_state_reg
anchors.why: PRBS31 checker LFSR state; logic disabled by default parameter.

anchors.name: prbs31_data_reg
anchors.why: PRBS31 mismatch bits counted into error count.

anchors.name: rx_error_count_reg
anchors.why: Per-block PRBS31 bit error count, sum of two partial popcounts.

groups.name: SERDES input alignment
groups.description: Optional bit reversal and pipeline registers on SERDES data and header.

groups.name: Descrambler
groups.description: 58-bit LFSR descrambler producing registered encoded data and header.

groups.name: Block sync and monitors
groups.description: Frame sync bitslip, BER monitor and watchdog reset/status logic.

groups.name: PRBS31 checker
groups.description: Optional PRBS31 pattern checker counting bit errors per block.
